title: Finite discrete internal exchange is realized from etale exchange
statement: Use the module sites of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] and the exchange construction of [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]. Fix a prime ℓ, a finite discrete commutative topological ring B killed by ℓ, a field k of positive prime characteristic different from ℓ, and separated finite-type k-schemes and k-morphisms X,Y,X′,Y′ forming any commutative square. Pull the condensed continuous-function ring of B to these schemes. For every bounded constructible complex N of internal B-module objects on X there are a functor F from the bounded-below derived category of etale sheaves of ULift B-modules on Y′ to the full derived category of internal B-module objects on Y′ and a bounded-below etale complex L on X, such that the specified internal-module boundedConstructibleBaseChange component at N and F applied to the specified etale baseChange component at L are isomorphic as arrows. No coefficient extension or integral reduction occurs here, and no properness, Cartesian, nonzero-ring, or exchange invertibility assumption is imposed.

The full triangulated realization has triangulated, isomorphism-closed essential image. Apply existing DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded with the constructible cohomology sheaves of N. This supplies L and an isomorphism F0(L) to N without invoking a separate constructible derived-origin theorem.

Transport bounded constructibility to F0(L). Compose the three commuting comparison squares using the generic three-step comparison structure. The defining three-factor formulas for the specified exchange maps give their arrow isomorphism at F0(L). Naturality of the internal exchange transports it along F0(L) isomorphic to N.
